name: ripls
description: Community building through sharing of goods and skills

scripts.postinstall: command -v pre-commit >/dev/null && pre-commit install --install-hooks || echo 'WARN: pre-commit not installed; gitleaks pre-commit hook not active. Run: brew install pre-commit && npm install (see README Setup Dependencies)'
scripts.clean: rm -rf server/gen app/lib/data/gen e2e/gen && find app -type f \( -name '*.freezed.dart' -o -name '*.mocks.dart' -o -name '*.g.dart' \) -delete
scripts.generate: npm run generate:proto && npm run generate:flutter && npm run generate:release-notes
scripts.generate:proto: npm run generate:proto:go && npm run generate:proto:dart && npm run generate:proto:ts
scripts.generate:flutter: cd app && flutter pub get && flutter gen-l10n && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
scripts.lint:go: npm run lint:go:fmt && npm run lint:go:vet && npm run lint:go:vet:benchmark && go run ./server/cmd/check-goroutines && go run ./server/cmd/check-sql && go run ./server/cmd/check-image-gps && npm run lint:go:codeinternal && npm run lint:go:event-terminology && npm run lint:go:active-community-gate && npm run lint:go:l10n-parity && npm run lint:go:no-inline-user-strings
scripts.lint:go:fmt: out=$(gofumpt -l .); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo 'gofumpt: these files are not formatted (run: npm run fmt:go)'; echo "$out"; exit 1; fi
scripts.lint:terraform: npm run fmt:terraform && npm run validate:terraform
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:go:fix && npm run fmt:terraform
scripts.lint: npm run lint:proto && npm run lint:go && npm run lint:go:size && npm run lint:terraform && npm run lint:dart && npm run lint:dart:size && npm run lint:dart:dead && npm run lint:dart:errortostring && npm run lint:dart:a11y && npm run lint:dart:colors && npm run lint:dart:ref-listen-in-build && npm run lint:dart:route-names && npm run lint:dart:viewmodel-tests && npm run lint:dart:l10n-parity && npm run lint:dart:arb-orphans && npm run lint:nav && npm run lint:ephemeral-comments && npm run lint:todo-refs && npm run lint:versions && npm run lint:go-vanity && npm run lint:context-map && npm run lint:design-tokens && npm run lint:glass-foreground && npm run lint:web:colors
scripts.build:app:android:dev: npm run generate && cd app && export GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY:-$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-android)} && flutter build apk --profile --dart-define-from-file=env.dev.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev mapbox-access-token) --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-client-places) --build-number=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
scripts.build:app:android:dev:release: npm run generate && cd app && export GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY:-$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-android)} && flutter build appbundle --release --dart-define-from-file=env.dev.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev mapbox-access-token) --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-client-places) --build-number=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
scripts.build:app:android:prod: npm run generate && cd app && export GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY:-$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod google-maps-api-key-android)} && flutter build appbundle --release --dart-define-from-file=env.prod.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod mapbox-access-token) --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod google-maps-api-key-client-places) --build-number=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
scripts.build:app:ios:dev: npm run generate && cd app && export GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY:-$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-ios)} && flutter build ipa --profile --dart-define-from-file=env.dev.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev mapbox-access-token) --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-client-places) --build-number=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
scripts.build:app:ios:prod: npm run generate && cd app && export GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY:-$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod google-maps-api-key-ios)} && flutter build ipa --release --dart-define-from-file=env.prod.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod mapbox-access-token) --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod google-maps-api-key-client-places) --build-number=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build:web:e2e && go build -o tmp/server ./server
scripts.build:web:local: npm run generate:proto:dart && cd app && flutter pub get && MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev mapbox-access-token) && FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev firebase-web-api-key) && GMK=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-web) && GPK=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-client-places) && flutter build web --wasm --profile --base-href=/ --dart-define-from-file=env.local.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GMK --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$GPK --dart-define=FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=$FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY && sed -i.bak "s/[$]GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY[$]/$GMK/g" build/web/index.html && rm -f build/web/index.html.bak && node ../scripts/precompress_web_bundle.js build/web && cd .. && find server/services/web/app_assets -mindepth 1 ! -name placeholder.html -delete && cp -R app/build/web/. server/services/web/app_assets/
scripts.build:web:e2e: npm run generate:proto:dart && cd app && flutter pub get && MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev mapbox-access-token) && FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev firebase-web-api-key) && GMK=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-web) && GPK=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-client-places) && flutter build web --wasm --profile --base-href=/ --dart-define-from-file=env.local.json --dart-define=AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GMK --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$GPK --dart-define=FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=$FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY && sed -i.bak "s/[$]GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY[$]/$GMK/g" build/web/index.html && rm -f build/web/index.html.bak && node ../scripts/precompress_web_bundle.js build/web && cd .. && find server/services/web/app_assets -mindepth 1 ! -name placeholder.html -delete && cp -R app/build/web/. server/services/web/app_assets/

scripts.build:web:prod: npm run generate:proto:dart && cd app && flutter pub get && MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod mapbox-access-token) && FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod firebase-web-api-key) && GMK=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod google-maps-api-key-web) && GPK=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod google-maps-api-key-client-places) && flutter build web --wasm --release --base-href=/ --dart-define-from-file=env.prod.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GMK --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$GPK --dart-define=FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=$FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY && sed -i.bak "s/[$]GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY[$]/$GMK/g" build/web/index.html && rm -f build/web/index.html.bak && node ../scripts/precompress_web_bundle.js build/web && cd .. && find server/services/web/app_assets -mindepth 1 ! -name placeholder.html -delete && cp -R app/build/web/. server/services/web/app_assets/
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f docker-local-postgres.yaml exec postgres psql -U ripls
scripts.metabase: docker compose -f docker-local-postgres.yaml --profile metabase up -d --wait metabase
scripts.metabase:stop: docker compose -f docker-local-postgres.yaml --profile metabase stop metabase
scripts.metabase:init: docker compose -f docker-local-postgres.yaml exec postgres psql -U ripls -f /dev/stdin < scripts/metabase-readonly-user.sql
scripts.start:server: npm run db:start && go build -o tmp/server ./server && scripts/run_server_with_sm_secrets.sh dev tmp/server --log-level=debug --log-format=text --log-source-location --notification-provider=fcm --firebase-project=$(scripts/gcp_project.sh dev) --db=postgres://ripls:ripls_dev@localhost:5432/ripls?sslmode=disable --local-media-storage=./media_storage --dev-mode --embedding-model-path=./model_tuning/ripls_embedding.onnx --embedding-vocab-path=./model_tuning/ripls_embedding_tokenizer/vocab.txt --invite-link-hostname=10.0.2.2:8080 --github-app-id=${GITHUB_APP_ID:-0} --github-installation-id=${GITHUB_INSTALLATION_ID:-0} --map-provider=google
scripts.start:app:dev: cd app && export GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY:-$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-ios)} && flutter run --profile --dart-define-from-file=env.dev.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev mapbox-access-token) --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-client-places)
scripts.start:app:local: cd app && export GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY:-$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-ios)} && flutter run --profile --dart-define-from-file=env.local.json --dart-define=MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev mapbox-access-token) --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=$GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_PLACES_KEY=$(../scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev google-maps-api-key-client-places)

scripts.test:impact: go test ./server/impact_metrics/... ./server/services/impact_metrics/... ./server/services/experience/... ./server/services/request/... && cd app && flutter test test/data/repositories/impact_repository_test.dart test/presentation/viewmodels/impact_draft_notifier_test.dart test/presentation/viewmodels/event_modal_view_model_test.dart test/presentation/widgets/impact/completion/ test/presentation/widgets/content/content_metric_sheet_gating_test.dart --reporter expanded && cd .. && npm run lint:dart:i18n
scripts.test:server:integration:sms: TWILIO_TEST_ACCOUNT_SID="$(scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev twilio-test-account-sid)" TWILIO_TEST_AUTH_TOKEN="$(scripts/fetch_secret.sh dev twilio-test-auth-token)" go test -tags=integration -run TwilioIntegration -v ./server/notifications/sms/
scripts.test:server:integration:sms:live: TWILIO_LIVE_ACCOUNT_SID="$(scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod twilio-account-sid)" TWILIO_LIVE_AUTH_TOKEN="$(scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod twilio-auth-token)" TWILIO_LIVE_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID="$(scripts/fetch_secret.sh prod twilio-messaging-service-sid)" go test -tags=integration -run TwilioLiveSend -v ./server/notifications/sms/
scripts.test:app: npm run generate && cd app && flutter analyze && flutter test --reporter expanded
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:app && npm run test:terraform
scripts.test:serial: npm run test:server:serial && npm run test:app && npm run test:terraform
scripts.validate:terraform:dev: cd terraform/environments/dev && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate
scripts.validate:terraform:prod: cd terraform/environments/prod && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate
scripts.validate:terraform: npm run validate:terraform:dev && npm run validate:terraform:prod
